data.name: Hasinah
data.gender_notes: Hasinah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-s-n', meaning 'beautiful, adorned'. In Islamic tradition, Hasinah represents the inner beauty and grace of a woman. The name Hasinah carries the meaning “Beautiful, adorned one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hasinah usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful, adorned one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Hasinah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful, adorned one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hasinah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: حسينة
in_arabic.meaning: حسينة تعني الجميلة والحسنة في الأخلاق والشكل
in_arabic.long_meaning: حسينة هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'حَسُنَ' الذي يعني الجمال والتحسين. يشير الاسم إلى الشخصية الجميلة في الأخلاق والشكل، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن الجمال والتحسين. يعتبر اسم حسينة من الأسماء ذات المعنى الجميل والسامي في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: حسینہ
in_urdu.meaning: حسینہ کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت اور اچھے اخلاق والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: حسینہ ایک عربی اصل کا اسم مؤنث ہے، جو 'حَسُنَ' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی اور اچھائی۔ یہ نام ان شخصیات کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اچھے اخلاق اور خوبصورتی کی حامل ہوتی ہیں۔ اسلامی تقویم میں، یہ نام اہل بیت اور اسلامی تاریخ میں معروف شخصیات کے ساتھ جڑا ہوا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हसीना
in_hindi.meaning: हसीना का अर्थ है सुंदर और अच्छे चरित्र वाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: हसीना एक अरबी मूल का स्त्रीलिंग नाम है, जो 'حَسُنَ' क्रिया से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है सुंदरता और अच्छाई। यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो अच्छे चरित्र और सुंदरता की धारक होती हैं। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अपनी सुंदरता और धार्मिक महत्व के लिए जाना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: حسینه
in_pashto.meaning: حسینه د ښکلا او ښو اخلاقو مانا ورکوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: حسینه د عربي اصلي ښځينه نوم دی، چې د 'حَسُنَ' کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی يې ښکلا او ښايسته والی ده. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کېږي چې ښو اخلاقو او ښکلا په ځان کې لري. په پښتني او افغان کلتور کې، دا نوم د خپل ښايست او مذهبي اهميت له امله مشهور دی.

in_english.name: Hasinah
in_english.long_meaning: Hasinah is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the verb 'حَسُنَ' (hasuna), meaning 'to be beautiful' or 'to be good'. The name signifies a person with beautiful character and morals. In Islamic tradition, the name is associated with beauty, goodness, and righteousness. It reflects the values of kindness, compassion, and spiritual growth. The name Hasinah is used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the aspiration for moral excellence and inner beauty.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hasinah holds cultural significance as it reflects the Arabic tradition of naming girls with beautiful and graceful names. The emphasis on inner beauty and grace aligns with the Islamic values of modesty, elegance, and feminine poise. It also adds to the painterly imagery of Middle Eastern dolls and literary characters, such as in the famous Arabic fairy tale, Aladdin, where Princess Badoura, the name of Aladdin's love interest, translates to 'the Beautiful One'.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic poetry and spirituality, the name Hasinah is a reminder of the inner beauty and grace that every woman embodies. The name embeds a sense of reverence for the divine feminine, celebrating the women as manifestations of God's benevolence, compassion, and care. It's not just about outer beauty, but the inner virtues and strengths that a woman possesses. The name inspires young girls to cultivate their inner beauty through learning, modesty, kindness, and eloquence. Moreover, it encourages men to treat all women with reverence and respect, recognizing their inherent beauty and grace.
